## Civics for All of US

[![We the People in the Constitution](https://www.archives.gov/files/education/civic-literacy/we-the-people-rectangle.png)](https://civics.archives.gov/)

**Civics for All of US** is the new education initiative from the National Archives that promotes civic literacy and engagement.

## DocsTeach

[![DocsTeach logo](https://www.archives.gov/files/education/images/docsteachhome500.jpg)](http://docsteach.org/)

Teach with documents using our online tool. Explore primary sources. Discover fun and engaging teaching activities. Create your own online or print activities for your students!

## Distance Learning

[![Children watching a distance learning program](https://www.archives.gov/files/education/distance-learning/images/studentsDLprogram.jpg)](https://www.archives.gov/education/distance-learning)

Visit the National Archives without leaving your home or school through our free distance learning programs for students and educators.

## Teaching With Documents

[![Magnifying glass on document](https://www.archives.gov/files/education/images/magnifyingglasscensus.jpg)](https://www.archives.gov/education/teaching-with-documents)

Teach students how to analyze primary sources using our worksheets for a variety of media types.

## Milestone Documents

[![Drawing of an eagle from the Great Seal](https://www.archives.gov/files/milestone-documents/images/great-seal-docteach-snippet.jpg)](https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/list)

Access primary sources related to pivotal moments in American history and government, including images, historical context, and transcriptions.
